writeAnnotationCopyFailed: Select the text to copy it manually.
writeAnnotationReattachHint: Select the passage again and choose Comment to attach it here.
writeAnnotationEarlierSuggestion: This suggestion belongs to the earlier passage. Ask Kun for a new suggestion here.
writeAnnotationSourceChanged: The original passage changed. Locate it again before previewing.
writeAnnotationPreviewBusy: Finish the current change review first.
writeAnnotationEmpty: Select a passage and choose Comment to leave a note.
writeAnnotationNeedModel: Select a connected model in Kun to ask about this passage.
writeAnnotationTooLong: Select a shorter passage to ask Kun.
writeAnnotationBusy: Kun is already replying in this discussion.
writeAnnotationTextLength: Enter an annotation of 1 to 16,000 characters.
writeAnnotationWrongDocument: The annotation no longer belongs to this document.
writeAnnotationInterrupted: The previous send was interrupted. Retry to continue.
writeAnnotationSlow: The reply is taking longer than expected. Retry to reconnect.
